sourceText:
在一个新的story中，制定合理的迁移计划，把以下 lattice 改掉，不考虑其他正在跑的story的影响
1、移除bin/lattice.js bin/lattice-codex.js
2、不再使用 .lattice 目录，改为使用 .proof-or-stop 目录
3、不再使用 .lattice-codex ，改为使用 .proof-or-stop-codex 目录
4、不再使用 lattice.config.json，改为使用 proof-or-stop.config.json
5、不再使用 lattice.json，改为使用 proof-or-stop.json
6、不再使用 @lattice/core 包名字，改为使用 @proof-or-stop/core 包名
normalizedOutcome: All six named lattice identities are retired: the two bin aliases are gone, the two state directories and two config/manifest filenames resolve under proof-or-stop names, and the workspace package is @proof-or-stop/core — while the 344 archived story directories remain readable and their historical signatures still verify.
acceptanceClaim: From a clean checkout: node bin/lattice.js fails with command-not-found; node bin/proof-or-stop.js session_brief and story_get both succeed reading state from .proof-or-stop; grep for @lattice/core outside node_modules/dist/state-dir returns nothing; and signature verification passes on two named archived stories from different eras.
